answer: Plates follow the state that issued them, not the state you live in, so since your car has California plates, you remove them and return them to the California motor vehicle agency within 10 days. We give you the plate return receipt, form NW-PLT-1, which shows the car was sold. Also note that because you're selling at a North Carolina store, a car registered in another state needs an emissions certificate from a North Carolina inspection station before we can buy it, and you should bring the registration from California.
